```{r}
# ---------------------Taxonomy for PHAGES: ----------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2); library(scales)
})

# PATHS ----------------------------------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "taxonomy")
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")

dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

phage_results <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")

# DATA -----------------------------------------------------------------------
df <- readr::read_csv(phage_results, show_col_types = FALSE)

# PALETTE --------------------------------------------------------------------
user_palette_pastel <- c(
  "Streptococcus"    = "pink",
  "Bacteroides"      = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Escherichia"      = "gold",
  "Faecalibacterium" = "#C499CC",
  "Bifidobacterium"  = "#6FA3F7",
  "Klebsiella"       = "#7B2CBF",
  "Blautia"          = "#90DDF0",
  "Gemmiger"         = "#FFAC81",
  "Ruminococcus"     = "#FA6459",
  "Veillonella"      = "darkgreen",
  "Pseudomonas"      = "#EEE2DF"
)
user_palette <- user_palette_pastel

# HELPERS --------------------------------------------------------------------
extract_clean_genus <- function(x){
  g <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "g__"),
              str_replace(x, ".*g__", ""),
              NA_character_)
  g <- sub("_[A-Z]$", "", g)
  dplyr::recode(g,
    "Kleibsella" = "Klebsiella",
    "Gemminger"  = "Gemmiger",
    .default = g
  )
}

base_prepare <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = dplyr::case_when(
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "1 week",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1    ~ "1 month",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6    ~ "6 months",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12   ~ "12 months",
        mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool"      ~ "mothers",
        bodysite == "breastmilk"                             ~ "milk",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    filter(CPM > 0) %>%
    mutate(Genus = extract_clean_genus(Host.genus)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Genus))
}

ensure_palette <- function(levels_vec, pal){
  miss <- setdiff(levels_vec, names(pal))
  if(length(miss) > 0){
    pal <- c(pal, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(miss)), miss))
  }
  pal
}

# PLOTS-----------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_top10 <- function(df,
                       include_other = FALSE,
                       top_from = c("all","stool"),
                       title = "Average proportional distribution of top-10 predicted host genera (CPM)"){

  top_from <- match.arg(top_from)

  dat <- base_prepare(df)

  cpm_by_sample_genus <- dat %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Genus) %>%
    summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")

  # ---- define TOP10 ----
  if(top_from == "stool"){
    cpm_for_top <- dat %>%
      filter(bodysite == "stool") %>%
      group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
      summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")
    top10 <- cpm_for_top %>%
      group_by(Genus) %>%
      summarise(global_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(global_CPM)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      pull(Genus)
  } else {
    top10 <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
      group_by(Genus) %>%
      summarise(global_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(global_CPM)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      pull(Genus)
  }

  df_top <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
    mutate(Genus = ifelse(Genus %in% top10, Genus, "Other"))

  prop <- df_top %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = total_CPM / sum(total_CPM)) %>%
    ungroup()

  group_mean <- prop %>%
    group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion), .groups = "drop")

  group_mean_norm <- group_mean %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    mutate(Mean_Proportion = Mean_Proportion / sum(Mean_Proportion)) %>%
    ungroup()

  if(!include_other){
    group_mean_norm <- group_mean_norm %>%
      filter(Genus != "Other") %>%
      group_by(Group) %>%
      mutate(Mean_Proportion = Mean_Proportion / sum(Mean_Proportion)) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  group_levels <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")
  group_mean_norm$Group <- factor(group_mean_norm$Group, levels = group_levels)

  genus_order <- group_mean_norm %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(tot = sum(Mean_Proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(tot)) %>%
    pull(Genus)

  if("Other" %in% genus_order){
    genus_order <- c("Other", setdiff(genus_order, "Other"))
  }
  group_mean_norm$Genus <- factor(group_mean_norm$Genus, levels = genus_order)

  pal <- ensure_palette(levels(group_mean_norm$Genus), user_palette)
  if("Other" %in% names(pal)) pal["Other"] <- "grey70"

  ggplot(group_mean_norm, aes(Group, Mean_Proportion, fill = Genus)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = "Predicted host genus", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
# RUN  ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT: top10 defined from stool ---------------------------------------
p_top10_noOther   <- plot_top10(df, include_other = FALSE, top_from = "stool")
p_top10_withOther <- plot_top10(df, include_other = TRUE,  top_from = "stool")

print(p_top10_noOther)

# SAVE  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
ggsave(filename = file.path(fig_dir, "phages_stool_10_host.png"),
       plot = p_top10_noOther, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "phages_stool_10_host.pdf"),
       p_top10_noOther, width = 11, height = 10, bg = "white")

ggsave(filename = file.path(fig_dir, "phages_stool_withother_host.png"),
       plot = p_top10_withOther, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "phages_stool_withother_host.pdf"),
       p_top10_withOther, width = 11, height = 10, bg = "white")

```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(ggpattern)
})

# PATHS ----------------------------------------------------------------------
bact_xlsx  <- here("data", "mmc3.xlsx")
phage_csv  <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")  # phages + metadata
out_dir    <- here("results", "figures", "phage_bacteria_combo")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# PALETTE --------------------------------------------------------------------
user_palette_pastel <- c(
  "Streptococcus"    = "pink",
  "Bacteroides"      = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Escherichia"      = "gold",
  "Faecalibacterium" = "#C499CC",
  "Bifidobacterium"  = "#6FA3F7",
  "Klebsiella"       = "#7B2CBF",
  "Blautia"          = "#90DDF0",
  "Gemmiger"         = "#FFAC81",
  "Ruminococcus"     = "#FA6459",
  "Pseudomonas"      = "#EEE2DF",
  "Veillonella"      = "darkgreen"
)

ensure_palette <- function(levels_vec, pal){
  miss <- setdiff(levels_vec, names(pal))
  if(length(miss) > 0){
    pal <- c(pal, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(miss)), miss))
  }
  pal
}

# HELPERS --------------------------------------------------------------------

collapse_split_suffix <- function(g){
  g %>%
    str_replace("_[A-Z]$", "") %>%
    str_trim()
}

extract_clean_phage_genus <- function(x){
  g <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "g__"),
              str_replace(x, ".*g__", ""),
              NA_character_)

  g <- collapse_split_suffix(g)

  g <- dplyr::recode(g,
    "Kleibsella" = "Klebsiella",
    "Gemminger"  = "Gemmiger",
    .default = g
  )

  g
}

# PHAGE + METADATA -----------------------------------------------------------
ph <- readr::read_csv(phage_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

meta <- ph %>%
  select(Sample, mother_infant, bodysite, timepoint_months) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "1 week",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1    ~ "1 month",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6    ~ "6 months",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12   ~ "12 months",
      mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool"      ~ "mothers",
      bodysite == "breastmilk"                             ~ "milk",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    HostClass = case_when(
      mother_infant == "infant" ~ "Infant",
      mother_infant == "mother" ~ "Mother",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group))

group_levels <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")

# PHAGE GENUS TABLE ----------------------------------------------------------
phage_genus <- ph %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%
  mutate(Genus = extract_clean_phage_genus(Host.genus)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(CPM_genus = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(CPM_total = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Rel_abund_phage = if_else(CPM_total > 0, CPM_genus / CPM_total, 0)) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

# LOAD MMC3 ----------------------------------------------------------
braw <- readxl::read_excel(bact_xlsx)
stopifnot("clade_name" %in% names(braw))

bnum <- braw %>%
  mutate(across(-clade_name, ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(.)))))

blong <- bnum %>%
  pivot_longer(-clade_name, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "percent") %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent)) %>%
  mutate(prop = percent / 100)

bact_genus <- blong %>%
  mutate(Genus = clean_bact_genus(clade_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus), Genus != "") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Rel_abund_bact = sum(prop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

# FILTER STOOL ONLY ---------------------------------------------------------
phage_stool <- phage_genus %>% filter(bodysite == "stool", !is.na(HostClass))
bact_stool  <- bact_genus  %>% filter(bodysite == "stool", !is.na(HostClass))
```

```{r}
# BACTERIA for PHAGE top10 host genera---------------------------------------
#          - no Other
#          - include milk 

# Top 10 host genera defined by phages --------------------------------------
top10_phage_genera <- phage_stool %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(global = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(global)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Genus)

# Bacteria: use bact_genus --------------------------------------------------
bact_for_phageTop10_noOther <- bact_genus %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%                      # meta is well joined
  filter(Genus %in% top10_phage_genera)

# Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_stack_fixed_list_noOther <- function(df, title, fill_title, palette){

  dat <- df %>%
    select(Sample, Group, Genus, Rel_abund_bact) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group), !is.na(Genus), Rel_abund_bact > 0)

  # sample proportion inside the sample (top10)
  prop <- dat %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Rel_abund_bact / sum(Rel_abund_bact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  group_mean <- prop %>%
    group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    mutate(Mean_Proportion = Mean_Proportion / sum(Mean_Proportion, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  group_levels2 <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")
  group_mean$Group <- factor(group_mean$Group, levels = group_levels2)

  genus_order <- group_mean %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(tot = sum(Mean_Proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(tot)) %>%
    pull(Genus)
  group_mean$Genus <- factor(group_mean$Genus, levels = genus_order)

  pal <- ensure_palette(levels(group_mean$Genus), palette)

  ggplot(group_mean, aes(Group, Mean_Proportion, fill = Genus)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = fill_title, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

p_bact_for_phageTop10_noOther <- plot_stack_fixed_list_noOther(
  df = bact_for_phageTop10_noOther,
  title = "Bacteria (MMC3) for phage top-10 host genera — incl. milk (no Other)",
  fill_title = "Bacterial genus",
  palette = user_palette_pastel
)

print(p_bact_for_phageTop10_noOther)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "BACT_for_PHAGE_top10_NO_OTHER_inclMilk.png"),
       p_bact_for_phageTop10_noOther, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "BACT_for_PHAGE_top10_NO_OTHER_inclMilk.pdf"),
       p_bact_for_phageTop10_noOther, width = 11, height = 10, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
## SAVE NUMBERS

# EXPORT TABLES: percentages used in plots -----------------------------------

# install.packages("writexl") # only if needed
library(writexl)

# PHAGES table: same values as p_top10_noOther -------------------------------

phage_table_percent <- phage_genus %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group), Genus %in% top10_phage_genera) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = total_CPM / sum(total_CPM, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(Mean_Proportion = Mean_Proportion / sum(Mean_Proportion, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels),
    Percentage = Mean_Proportion * 100,
    Percentage_rounded = round(Percentage, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Percentage)) %>%
  select(Group, Genus, Percentage, Percentage_rounded)

# BACTERIA table: same values as p_bact_for_phageTop10_noOther ---------------

bacteria_table_percent <- bact_for_phageTop10_noOther %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Genus, Rel_abund_bact) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group), !is.na(Genus), Rel_abund_bact > 0) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Rel_abund_bact / sum(Rel_abund_bact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(Mean_Proportion = Mean_Proportion / sum(Mean_Proportion, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels),
    Percentage = Mean_Proportion * 100,
    Percentage_rounded = round(Percentage, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Percentage)) %>%
  select(Group, Genus, Percentage, Percentage_rounded)

# SAVE xlsx ------------------------------------------------------------------

write_xlsx(
  list(
    Phages = phage_table_percent,
    Bacteria = bacteria_table_percent
  ),
  path = file.path(out_dir, "phage_bacteria_percentages_by_group_genus.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
# % explained by top10 host genera -------------------------------------------

top10_summary <- phage_genus %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months", "mothers", "milk")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_top10 = Genus %in% top10_phage_genera
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_total = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    top10_fraction = sum(CPM_genus[is_top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
                     first(sample_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_top10_percent = round(mean(top10_fraction) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top10_summary
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

extract_clean_phage_genus <- function(x){
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    # extract genus if it comes like g__Bacteroides
    ifelse(str_detect(., "g__"),
           str_replace(., ".*g__", ""),
           .) %>%
    # delete all that comes after |
    str_replace("\\|.*$", "") %>%
    # delete sufixes GTDB like _A, _B, _C
    str_replace("_[A-Z]$", "") %>%
    # delete multiple spaces
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}
```
